components.name: Segment Service Index
components.description: Faceted seven-segment numerals paired with plain-language service names.
components.html: Product design
components.css: .ds-service-index { display: flex; min-height: 90px; align-items: center; gap: clamp(18px, 3vw, 48px); padding: 12px 4%; color: #f5eee7; font: 400 clamp(1rem, 1.5vw, 1.35rem) Varta, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-segment-number { --digit-width: 30px; --digit-height: 48px; --bar-size: 7px; display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: stretch; gap: 7px; color: #555351; } .ds-segment-red { color: #d83e2c; } .ds-digit { position: relative; display: block; flex: 0 0 var(--digit-width); width: var(--digit-width); height: var(--digit-height); } .ds-segment { position: absolute; display: block; background: currentColor; } .ds-a, .ds-g, .ds-d { left: 5px; width: calc(var(--digit-width) - 10px); height: var(--bar-size); clip-path: polygon(4px 0, calc(100% - 4px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 4px) 100%, 4px 100%, 0 50%); } .ds-a { top: 0; } .ds-g { top: calc(50% - var(--bar-size) / 2); } .ds-d { bottom: 0; } .ds-b, .ds-c, .ds-e, .ds-f { width: var(--bar-size); height: calc((var(--digit-height) - var(--bar-size) - 10px) / 2); clip-path: polygon(0 4px, 50% 0, 100% 4px, 100% calc(100% - 4px), 50% 100%, 0 calc(100% - 4px)); } .ds-b, .ds-f { top: 4px; } .ds-c, .ds-e { bottom: 4px; } .ds-b, .ds-c { right: 4px; } .ds-e, .ds-f { left: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Kuroba's name means “black feather.” The identity turns that literal meaning into a mark assembled from dark, faceted feather forms, with a few vermilion and amber segments carrying the signal. The surrounding interface feels like a quiet instrument panel: nearly black, lightly textured, precise in its dividers, and warm in its typography. The page pairs a large, direct statement with compact indexed service information. Varta keeps the voice human and readable; Geist Mono supplies the measured numeric register. Color is concentrated in calls to action and selected indices, while the feather stays mostly in shadow. The studio's established promise is to design and build web apps end to end.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces with warm white type and a faint field texture.
One vermilion signal, balanced by amber as a secondary signal.
Feather geometry and segmented numerals as recurring identity devices.
Editorial scale paired with simple ruled lists and generous breathing room.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve vermilion and amber for actions, indices, and selected states; let the black feather and surrounding field remain mostly dark.

rules.name: The Two-Registers Rule
rules.body: Use Varta for messages and headings; use Geist Mono for counts and compact technical indices.

rules.name: The Instrument-Panel Rule
rules.body: Separate content with tonal shifts, texture, and hairlines; keep large surfaces flat and avoid ambient shadow.

dos: Do keep the black feather as the identity's central image and let most of its facets stay in shadow.
Do use vermilion for the primary action and amber for secondary numbering or focus.
Do organize information with generous spacing, clear rows, and subtle rules.
Do use real seven-segment geometry for brand indices rather than plain monospaced digits.
Do retain a visible keyboard focus treatment and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add unverified client work, metrics, or claims as visual proof.
Don't fill large areas with accent color or make every feather segment bright.
Don't turn simple lists into decorative card grids or add broad drop shadows.
Don't replace the segmented brand numerals with a generic icon or arbitrary display glyph.
